title: BlockTools
description: This mod adds tools from almost all blocks.
body:
BlockTools — Craft Tools From Any Block!

![tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f9008e1d5ec1317d191378995a30dc100c6848f.jpeg)

367 block materials × 5 tool types = 1,835 unique craftable items. Every single one has its own texture and a unique special ability.

![ability](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc7fb34983f6773cd38feaa47c9661ea71103148.jpeg)

What is this mod?

BlockTools lets you craft a Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, and Sword from virtually any block in Minecraft 1.20.1. Want a Magma Block pickaxe that leaves fire under every mob you hit? A Blue Ice sword that stacks deeper and deeper freeze with every strike? A Lodestone sword that magnetically pulls every nearby mob toward you before impact? Now you can.

![pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ff623f013ed0423228b06844dfcabf094d588ae.jpeg)

Mod has RU, EN and DE localizations.
